_comment: End-to-end evaluation set (L3). 'core' scenarios are what a correct system must pass; 'stretch' scenarios need real model reasoning (the deterministic stub is scripted and cannot pass them, they are reported separately). 'support' gives the passage that justifies the expected outcome as a verbatim quote, matched against the text of CITED passages, so it survives a change of corpus (clause ids may change; quotes are updated).
corpus: app/agents.py stand-in private-car corpus (replace quotes when Person B's index is wired in)
